name: HTML/CSS to Image
summary: Render HTML and CSS, or a live web page, into a PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF image hosted at a permanent URL.

api_id.description: your HTML/CSS to Image User/API ID (dashboard > API keys); the Basic auth username

api_key.description: the API key paired with that id; the Basic auth password

notes: HTTP Basic auth: the API ID is the username and the API key the password. Keys can be scoped (images:create, images:read, images:delete, usage:read).
Management reads (images list, usage) are limited to 100 requests a minute; 429 there is a rate limit, separate from image credits.

endpoints.name: Render HTML/CSS or a URL to an image
endpoints.summary: Renders HTML with CSS, or screenshots a live URL, and returns the id and permanent URL of the image.

html.description: HTML to render. This or url is required, not both.

url.description: A public web page to screenshot, instead of html.

google_fonts.description: Google Font names to load, e.g. 'Roboto|Open Sans'.

selector.description: Crop the image to the element matching this CSS selector.

ms_delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before capture, for JavaScript; about 500 is a good start.

max_wait_ms.description: Upper bound on waiting for the page, 500 to 10000.

render_when_ready.description: Wait until the page calls ScreenshotReady().

viewport_width.description: Viewport width in px; set with viewport_height.

viewport_height.description: Viewport height in px; set with viewport_width.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the page.

block_consent_banners.description: Hide cookie consent banners on url captures.

format.description: Output format; also selectable later by the URL's extension. Default png.

dedupe_duration_s.description: Reuse an identical image made within this many seconds, at no credit cost.

notes: Each new image consumes image credits from the plan (jumbo sizes consume more); 429 means the plan's image credits are used up.
The returned url is permanent while the account is active and CDN-cached; append .jpg/.webp/.pdf to change format and ?width=/height= (max 5000) to resize.

count.description: Images per page, at most 50; default 50.

endpoints.name: Get image usage
endpoints.summary: Images rendered per hour, day and month, and per billing period.
notes: hour, day and month are views of the same usage; do not add them up.

endpoints.name: Delete an image
endpoints.summary: Deletes a rendered image so its URL stops working.

image_id.description: The image id returned by image.create.
